label: quadcorner
notes: Four-corner gradient REPLACES the one-corner snake (SNAKE_W=0). Weight 25 = 100x the snake's 0.25 ON PURPOSE: the entire snake advantage for an ordered wall measures 95 points, under a third of one empty cell, so a snake-sized quad weight cannot change play. At 25 a corner 1024 scores 25 600, comparable to its own 9216 sSum — the scale at which position can outvote mass. Free at run time (folded into the existing per-row table). PAIRED with baseline.json — same seeds, same depth.
